product_flow.name: Qualified completed inland refrigerated-compartment carriage engagement

functional_unit.what: Qualified completed inland refrigerated-compartment carriage engagement
functional_unit.how_much: 1 Item(s): one declared qualified service engagement, with mandatory actual manifest amount and route/cold-duty conditions
functional_unit.how_well: One engagement is the originally specified inland cold-carriage obligation for a declared manifest quantity, cargo identity/state, pickup, actual inland route and custody interval, receiving handoff and temperature/time/quality acceptance. Count the engagement once only when that original obligation is completed and accepted. An independently documented contemporaneous accepted segment or amended engagement can qualify on its own declared function; do not retrospectively shrink failed scope, lower quality limits or count the original and amended service together. Partial/damaged/late/refused consignments are not automatically complete. N is the positive number of equivalent qualified completed engagements; N=0 has no finite service intensity. Actual cargo mass/volume, distance, duration and thermal conditions remain mandatory; Item(s) is a service count, not a vessel, cargo piece, tonne-km or hold-hour.
functional_unit.how_long_or_cycle: Actual declared pickup/cold-custody start to final receiving handoff/custody end, measured elapsed duration and original voyage/engagement reporting cycle; supporting duty and same-asset all-user useful-life periods are declared separately. Declare actual cargo chilled/frozen state and required temperature band, tolerances, permitted excursion duration, humidity/ventilation/atmosphere if relevant, calibrated hold/product sensor locations and custody start/end. Record actual inlet quality, product and air/secondary-fluid time-temperature history, doors/hold openings, loading sequence, heat sources and accepted receiver state. An air setpoint or running compressor alone does not prove product quality or completion. Separate cooling/holding/re-cooling/defrost from independent freezing/processing sold outside this carriage obligation. Prior quality damage is recorded, not reversed by icing; rescue/re-cooling and failed-service burdens remain attributed even where output is refused. No universal frozen-food or fish temperature requirement.
